need: Observe complete required S1/S2 source files while preserving bounded IO, exact kernel identity and refusal guarantees.
scope: Shared ownership file observation and native source-reference verification; no authority or review weakening.
ceiling_state: analysis required before implementation; any prospective revision must be frozen before authoring assessed code

reserved_cases.case: Required complete files produce present with kernel id of all actual bytes, not transport SHA or truncated prefix.
Same first 256000 bytes with a single differing byte near the end produces different input versions; restored exact bytes reproduce exact version.
Previously accepted files at/below256000 retain identical ownership-source version1 kernel identity.
Exactly declared hard limit admitted; one byte over refused unavailable; never absent.
Native source_ref Git blob/SHA checks use all bytes under identical ceiling; tail corruption fails hash.
Streaming reads stop after at most bounded chunk overflow; pre-read size bound where applicable; no unlimited allocation; analysis quantifies live copies/canonical serialization.
Symlinks, forbidden .git/.atlas, traversal and non-files still refused.
Read failure, incomplete/mutated file and oversize remain unavailable, distinct from corroborated absent.
No discarded inputs/build deps/source_refs and no replacement of full source by summary to make prepare pass.
Implementation change creates a new candidate/binding; old PASS and sample CI not transplanted.
Scope tests execute via existing GitHub Actions at exact code commit; local product tests prohibited.
Actual remote max-size execution metrics and memory/CPU analysis support ceiling; generated test not standalone performance claim.

allowed_unknowns: Universal race freedom outside existing observer contract
